correctness.rationale: For every odd n≥5, in fixed Euclidean coordinates, F_n={x≥0,x_i+x_{i+1}≤1}, P_n(s)=F_n∩{∑x_i≤(n−s)/2}, 0≤s≤1. The transfer integral operator Tf(u)=∫₀^{1−u}f(v)dv has complete cosine eigenfunctions and eigenvalues 2(−1)^j/((2j+1)π), so V(F_n)=E_{n−1}/[2(n−1)!]. Coordinate facets are isometric to path fractional polytopes with area E/(n−1)!, and divergence with radial origin shows each edge facet area √2V(F_n), giving S(F_n)=nE(1+1/√2)/(n−1)!. With y_i=1−x_i−x_{i+1}, odd n yields det(I+P)=2 and removes exactly the homothetic simplex ∑y_i<s, y_i≥0, of volume s^n/(2n!), base area s^{n−1}√n/(n−1)! and n removed old-edge facet areas each s^{n−1}/[√2(n−1)!]. No coordinate-facet interior is removed for s≤1. Hence V=E/[2(n−1)!]−s^n/(2n!) and S=nE(1+1/√2)/(n−1)!−(n/√2−√n)s^{n−1}/(n−1)!. Normalization gives I(s)/I(0)=(1−a s^{n−1})/(1−b s^n)^((n−1)/n) with a=(1−√(2/n))/[(1+√2)E], b=1/(nE); derivative has exact sign of bs−a. Thus n=5 has unique interior minimum s*=0.761209517..., while every odd n≥7 decreases to unique s=1 minimum; full cut worsens relative to s=0 only at n=5. Expanding as E→∞ proves E(1−I(1)/I(0))→√2−1. Independent numerical evaluation of exact formulas checked n=5,7,9 signs; inspected exact determinant/Gram checker tests n=3,5,7,9 without taking finite checks as proof.
